bull_bear.body:
- Net cash balance sheet: Net Debt to Equity of -0.4x, -0.2x, -0.1x, -0.1x, -0.1x for FY22-FY26, described as "Healthy Balance Sheet with Consistent Cash Flow Generation".
- Net Worth grew 207, 274, 332, 387, 424 Rs Cr over FY22-FY26 with TOL/TNW of 0.9, 0.6, 0.7, 0.6, 0.7x.
- Cash Flow from Operations of 55, 27, 55, 52, 78 Rs Cr over FY22-FY26; cash and cash equivalents of Rs 99.3 Cr at Mar-26.
- Credit rating: Long Term CRISIL A/Stable and Short Term CRISIL A1, on total bank loan facilities rated Rs 194 Cr (Mar-25), enhanced from Rs 158 Cr.
- The deck makes no statement on dividend policy or buybacks.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Claims "World Leader in Cotton Ginning Machinery" and states it is the "Only company worldwide offering all four ginning technologies - Single Roller, Double Roller, Saw-Ginning & Roto-Bar Ginning Technologies", a position attributed to the 2012 acquisition of Continental Eagle (USA).
- Cotton Processing Machinery division claims "~35-40% Global Market Share, 50% Domestic Share, 50%+ Revenue from Exports, Presence in 60+ Countries" and "Awarded India's Largest & Most Modern Cotton Ginning Machinery Maker - Ministry of Textiles".
- 64 years of legacy, listed on BSE since 1986, with "3,000+ Cotton Ginning Plants Supplied" and presence across 60+ countries.
- Technology/quality anchors cited: technical collaboration with CIRCOT (ICAR, Govt. of India) since 2011, and channel-partner status with Schneider Electric, ABB and Mitsubishi.
- Consolidated Order Book of Rs 605 Cr across Cotton Ginning Machinery and other segments as on August 8, 2026.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Subsidiaries] Four wholly owned subsidiaries: Bajaj Coneagle LLC (USA), Bajaj Steel Industries (U) Ltd (Uganda), Bajaj Continental LTDA (Brazil) and Bajaj Services LTDA (Brazil); the key-strengths slide describes these as "4 Subsidiaries in USA, Uganda, Brazil".
- [Segment order books] As on 8th Aug 2026: Cotton Processing Machinery Rs 376 Cr, Infrastructure Rs 85 Cr, Heavy Engineering Rs 75 Cr, Electrical Panels Rs 54 Cr, Other Products Rs 15 Cr; the consolidated figure quoted is Rs 605 Cr.
- [Corporate actions] Management bios reference past strategic initiatives including a slump sale, settlements, funding, delisting, promoter reclassification and land acquisition, without further detail.
- [Shareholding] Promoters 56.62%, FII 0.04%, DII 0.01%, Public 43.35% as on 30th June 2026; face value Rs 5, shares outstanding 2.08 Cr.
- [Sales network] Sales offices in Brazil, Peru, Paraguay, Argentina, Australia, West Africa, East Africa, CIS and GCC countries; head office and manufacturing at MIDC Hingna/Butibori, Nagpur.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Bajaj Steel Industries as "A Multi-Product Engineering Company" that has evolved since 1961 from a cotton ginning machinery maker into a five-division engineering group, claiming world leadership in cotton ginning machinery alongside Infrastructure (PEB), Electrical Panels, Heavy Engineering and other products.
